genetic variation sensuo lato had greater effects on plant traits and on associated arthropod density and community composition than did sexual dimorphism in the common garden study of Baccharis genotypes.

the role that genetic variation in traits plays in shaping plant–herbivore interactions and associated arthropods.
the role of intraspecific genetic variation in shaping the structure and functioning of ecological communities.
